Everything on Kiddo.school is published in good faith for general information and family learning. We do not guarantee that it is complete, accurate or suitable for every child. Classes, activities and worksheets are not medical, developmental, therapeutic or teaching advice. Age ranges are guides, never tests or deadlines. If you have a concern about your child’s health or development, please speak with a qualified professional.

Adult supervision

Some activities use scissors, small objects, seeds, water, paint or kitchen items. Choose what suits your child, stay close, and keep small parts away from children who still put things in their mouths. You are responsible for the safety of the children you look after.
